purpose: Define reproducible external data roles for modern constellation boundaries and source-star coordinates without confusing IAU constellation boundaries with project-owned connect-the-stars geometry or copying external catalogues before redistribution/provenance review.
bindingPipeline: Record exact source version/retrieval date/checksum before importing any external machine-readable dataset.

Review terms/licensing/redistribution before vendoring source data in the repository; if redistribution is unclear, store a deterministic fetch/import recipe plus derived minimal records instead of copying a catalogue wholesale.
Normalize Hipparcos positions to the adopted coordinate frame/epoch before testing constellation membership or normalizing into local SVG viewBox coordinates.
Use IAU boundary data as the membership/boundary authority; CDS VI/49 may be used as a machine-readable cross-check/import convenience but may not outrank the IAU definition.
Create a minimal per-star project record keyed by HIP identifier with provenance and normalized coordinates; do not copy unrelated catalogue fields.
Human-author project line segments only after the admitted star set and normalized positions are deterministic.
Version every project line graph separately from the external star/boundary dataset binding so an art revision does not rewrite source astronomy data.
nextGate: Complete source licensing/redistribution review and implement a deterministic minimal-data import/normalization manifest; keep exactStarCoordinateDatasetBound=false until that import is reproducible and reviewed.
